exposure: vaginal bleeding in the second trimester
outcome: delivery within 4 weeks of fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP)
cohort: The study included 304 patients who received fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) of placental anastomoses for twin-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS).
finding: Independent predictors of delivery within 4 weeks of FLP were a history of PTD, vaginal bleeding in the second trimester, and amnioreduction >=1715 mL.
followup_time: Up to 4 weeks after fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP)
